title: NullPointerException during login
description: Login endpoint throws an exception when user profile is missing
comments: Occurs only for accounts created before migration
resolution: Check missing profile and initialize default profile

title: Database connection timeout
description: Service cannot acquire database connection after restarting MySQL
stack_trace: java.sql.SQLTransientConnectionException: Connection is not available request timed out
comments: Hikari pool exhausted after spike in traffic
resolution: Review pool sizing and ensure connections close

title: File upload fails for UTF8 logs
description: Uploading a log with invalid byte encoding causes decoding error
resolution: Validate file encoding and return friendly error

title: Page freezes after long API response
description: Dashboard freezes when request returns slowly
stack_trace: TimeoutError client request exceeded time budget
resolution: Use abort handling and loading state for slow requests

title: Incorrect duplicate warning after retry
description: Same request is submitted repeatedly after network retry
resolution: Use idempotency key and deduplicate operations
